paite: Ka ki-uangsak lai ding hi. Ka phattuampih ding a-om kei na a, Toupa kiang a kipan mengmuhna leh kilakna thu ka genzom lai ding hi.
heading: Paul Mengmuhna Leh Kilakna
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

paite: Khrist a mi khat ka thei; huai mi tuh kum sawm-le-li ahita a, pumpi in hia a-om ka thei kei, pumpi lou in hia a-om ka thei sam kei; Pathian in athei, van thumna hial ah laktouh in a-om hi.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

paite: Huai mi mahmah, pumpi in hia a-om, pumpi lou in hia ka thei kei; Pathian in athei hi;
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

paite: paradis a laktouh a a-omdan, thu genkhiak vual louh, mihing gensiangloute aza chih ka thei hi.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

paite: Mi huchibang ahihleh ka suang ding; himahleh ka hatlouhna lou zaw keimah ka kisuang kei ding hi.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

paite: Suan ut mah leng mihai ka hi kei ding, thutak tak ka gen dek ngal a; himahleh ka kidek ding, huchi lou in zaw kuapeuh in hon muh bang uleh ka lak a thu azak sang un hon ngai thupizaw kha ding uhi.
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

paite: Huan kilakna thupi mahmah ziak a ka kingaihlet luatlouhna ding in ka sa ah ling hon pia ahi, Setan sawltak, khut thak nuhna dia hon zang ding ngei; huchi lou in zaw ka kingailian kha ding hi.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

paite: Huai thil tungtang thu ah hon awngsut theihna ding in Toupa thumvei ka ngen hi.
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Ka hehpihna nang a ding in ahun hi, hatlouhna ah ahi ka thilhihtheihna hihkim a a-om,” achi hi. Huchi in Khrist thilhihtheihna ka tung a a-omtheihna ding in kipaktak in ka hatlouhnate ka suang zaw ding hi.
english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist ziak a hatlouhna ah, liamna ah, taksapna ah, sawina ah, lungngaihna ah ka kipak zel hi; ka hat louh peuhpeuh chiang in ahi ka hat zawk zel.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

paite: Hai ka na hita; nou hai lou thei lou in na hon bawl ua ahi; bangmah hi kei mah leng, noumau na hon pahtawi ding uh ka hi, bang lam peuh ah leng sawltaklian thuneipente ka pha lou kei hi.
heading: Paul In Korinthte A-awlmoh
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

paite: Ka sawltaklian hih chiamtehnate kuhkalna chiteng toh chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, nasep thupite in na lak uah hih ahi taktak hi.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

paite: Bang lam ah ahia, saptuam pawl dangte sang a niamzaw a bawl a na omna uh? Keimah ngeingei in ka hon hihbuailouhna lam thu ah ahih kei ngalleh. Huai diklouhna ah hon ngaidam un.
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

paite: Ngai un, hiai na kiang ua hong hoh ding ka sawm athumveina ahi; noute ka hon hihbuai kei ding, na thilneihte uh hilou in noumau hon deih ka hi zaw hi; tate'n nu leh pate a ding in akholkhawmsak ding uh ahi kei a, nu leh pate'n tate ding in akholkhawmsak zaw ding uh ahi.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

paite: Huan kei zaw na kha ua ding in kipaktak in ka kizangbei ding a, ka kizangbei vek lai ding hi. Akan-aval a nou ka hon it ziak in ke'n noute itna tawmzaw muhna in ka nei ahi maw?
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

paite: Himahleh kei mahmah in ka hon hihbuailouhna ah kei lepchiahpil leh khemna a noute hon man na sa ua hiam.
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

paite: Na kiang ua ka misawl kuahiamte zang in nou ka hon hamphatpih ngei a hia?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

paite: Noute kiang a hong pai ding in Titas ka ngen a, amah toh unaupa ka hon sawl hi. Titas in nou ahon hamphatpih himhim hia? Kha kibang a gamtakhawm ka hi kei ua hia? Khap kibang a pai ka hi kei ua hia?
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

paite: Noumau kiang a kou leh kou kihu na hon sa ua hia? Khrist ah Pathian mitmuh in ahi thu ka gen uh. Himahleh deihtakte aw, bangkim noumau bawlhoihna ding ahi.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

paite: Ka hong pai chiang in bangchi hiam a ka lamet bang a ka hon muh keileh kei deih bang in na hon mu kei kha ding uh chih leh bangchi hiam in kitainate, kihazatnate, hehnate, kilangkhennate, kigennate, kihuaukhumnate, kingaihlet luatnate, buainate a om in ka hon mu kha ding chih ka lau hi.
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

paite: Na kiang ua ka hong nawn chiang in ka Pathian in na lak uah hon hih zahlak in thil hihkhialte leh thilsiang lou hihte, kingaite, huk ching a kisik tuan lou, mi tampite ka kahkhum kha ding chih ka lau hi.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
